rival_meanings.always_column: Reflect across the pivot column without a side predicate.
rival_meanings.always_row: Reflect across the pivot row without a side predicate.
rival_meanings.both_original: Per pass, copy along every satisfied axis from that pass's original cells, omitting composed diagonal images.
rival_meanings.center_col: Use the9 pivot row and canvas center column.
rival_meanings.center_row: Use the canvas center row and the9 pivot column.
rival_meanings.clamp: Clamp reflected destinations to the nearest edge instead of clipping.
rival_meanings.column_only: Use only the column-side branch, otherwise no-op.
rival_meanings.crop_result: Crop the completed result to its nonzero bounding box.
rival_meanings.drop_pivot: Run correct passes, then erase all9 cells.
rival_meanings.else_column: After both side predicates fail, incorrectly reflect across the pivot column.
rival_meanings.else_row: After both side predicates fail, incorrectly reflect across the pivot row.
rival_meanings.erase_clipped_sources: Erase source cells whose reflected destinations are out of bounds.
rival_meanings.first_color_copies: Paint every reflected copy in the first motif cell's color.
rival_meanings.fixed_copies2: Paint every reflected copy in fixed color2.
rival_meanings.geometric_fourfold: Per pass, use original side predicates to include column, row and composed diagonal images, even when an earlier actual pass would clip entirely.
rival_meanings.global_center: Use the lower integer canvas center as pivot.
rival_meanings.largest_component_only: Reflect only the largest non9 component, choosing its own branch; ties use occupied-anchor order.
rival_meanings.move_copy: Erase the source motif before drawing its reflection at every pass.
rival_meanings.per_color: Choose a branch independently for each non0/9 color at every pass.
rival_meanings.per_component: Choose a branch independently for each same-color4-connected component.
rival_meanings.pivot_plus_col: Use a pivot one column right of the actual9.
rival_meanings.pivot_plus_row: Use a pivot one row below the actual9.
rival_meanings.reject_clipped: Reject the entire selected reflection if even one destination is out of bounds.
rival_meanings.rotate180: Copy a180-degree pivot rotation instead of the selected single-axis reflection.
rival_meanings.row_only: Use only the row-side branch, otherwise no-op.
rival_meanings.row_priority: At every pass, prefer row-side reflection over column-side reflection.
rival_meanings.wrap: Wrap reflected destinations around the canvas instead of clipping.
